digest.component_or_area: Cloud Jira adapter pagination error handling
propositions: RunawayPaginationError subclasses RuntimeError instead of BackendPaginationStallError, placing it outside the core stall error hierarchy
fetch_snapshot's three enrichment fail-open handlers match on BackendPaginationStallError type and miss Cloud's RunawayPaginationError, allowing broad except Exception clauses to swallow the error
A stalled Cloud cursor produces a silently degraded snapshot instead of propagating the error and aborting the reconciliation pass
Changing RunawayPaginationError to subclass BackendPaginationStallError allows the three fetcher re-raise clauses to catch and propagate the stall error
Existing except RuntimeError sites remain unaffected because BackendPaginationStallError subclasses RuntimeError, preserving backward compatibility
Non-stall enrichment failures must continue to fail open and write degraded snapshots, not be broken by the fix
